messages:
Maya: FYI — Acme reached out asking to delay migration off model-redwood-3b. They have a finetuned pipeline that breaks on the v4 tokenizer. Can we discuss a short-term pin exception?
Kevin: thanks for flagging. do we have the exact failure mode? tokenizer mismatch or output drift?
Maya: tokenizer mismatch. they sent a small repro. says tokens shift ~5% for long prompts.
Sarah: pin exceptions need a clear SLA and sunset plan. proposals: (1) customer pinned + audit every 2w, (2) migration window w/ support runbook, or (3) temporary forked artifact with compat tokenizer.
Juan: +1 on sunset plan. also need perf/bench numbers to justify continued promo on catalog. if pinned, we should prevent automatic updates and mark as "compat-exception" in catalog metadata.
Kevin: lean toward option 2 unless we can quickly patch tokenization. Patching might break other customers, need canary.
Maya: Acme prefers a month extension to finish internal validation. asking for minimal disruption.
Sarah: official criteria for granting pin exception (draft):
```
- documented customer impact and repro
- expected duration <= 90 days (prefer 30)
- assigned eng owner + weekly check-ins
- rollback/kill-switch plan in console
- audit logs enabled
```
Kevin: add: must include perf baseline (p50/p95) and a small eval set for quality regression checks.
Juan: operational constraints: pinned models consume dedicated storage/cache. we should estimate incremental cost and include on estimates.
catalog-bot: Reminder: creating a pin-exception requires a ticket in #eng-releases with label `pin-exception` and a migration task in the model-catalog board.
Maya: created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2147 — brief in description + attached repro. tagging @Kevin for eng owner.
Kevin: assigned. I'll scope the patch vs. temporary compatibility wrapper. ETA: EOD tomorrow for decision.
Sarah: for product: if we grant, we'll attach a clear launch gate for removal: either when tokenization alignment >= 99% on Acme eval or after 30 days, whichever first. We should capture customer signoff for the cutover plan.
Maya: noted. I'll draft customer email with options and ask for their preferred 30/60/90 window.
Juan: also document the migration cutover checklist (short):
- notify customer 72h before
- create canary route + monitor RMSE/embedding cosine drop
- rollback plan (route back to pinned)
- post-mortem if regression > threshold

Kevin: quick question re: catalog metadata fields for exception — we need `exception_reason`, `owner`, `expires_at`, `cost_estimate`. ops ok with that?
catalog-bot: New metadata fields suggested: `pin_exception` (bool), `exception_owner`, `exception_expiry`, `exception_notes`. Admin UI will show warning banner for pinned models.
Sarah: perfect. product to author schema PR after decision.
Maya: agreed. Thanks everyone. will update after customer responds. :thumbsup:
Kevin: thanks — ping me if customer sends repro patch.
Juan: adding a short note to the runbook about eviction behavior for pinned models.
Maya: closing thread for now, will reopen with updates.
thread_summary: Customer requested pin exception for tokenizer compatibility. Team discussed criteria (duration, owner, audit, perf baselines), operational cost, catalog metadata changes, and a migration cutover checklist. Ticket INF-2147 created; eng to decide on patch vs temp wrapper by EOD tomorrow.
